title: Fall Daylong Yoga & Meditation Retreat at Green Gulch Farm & Zen Center
description: Come for a grounding, refreshing, healing and elevating day of asana, meditation, breathwork, kriya, and chanting with Kari Marble in Marin.
long_description:
Come for a grounding, refreshing, healing and elevating day of asana, meditation, breathwork, kriya, and chanting with Kari Marble in Marin.

About this Event

Connect with your inner spaciousness, clarity, heart and voice. Take time for a hike, self reflection, journaling, or nature bathing in the gentle and peaceful beauty of the grounds and nearby ocean and coastal bluffs.
Includes: a full day of yogic practices, delicious vegetarian lunch from the Green Gulch gardens, optional walk to Muir Beach, use of the grounds, and tea.

About the Venue : Green Gulch Farm & Zen Center is located in Marin right off Highway 1 en route to Muir Beach and Stinson.

About 30 minutes north of the Golden Gate Bridge, Green Gulch sits nestled in a valley amidst rolling hills, beautiful gardens, and hiking trails that open out to the Pacific Ocean at Muir Beach. Our retreat room is surrounded by trees, birdsong and deeply peaceful energy.
In our loving circle together we activate deep and wise presence within to support clear seeing, connection to Self, arising of insights, and transformation. Profound shifts can happen even in just one day.

Space is limited to 16 participants.

Cancellation policy - 30+ days before retreat: full refund less $30 processing fee. Within 30 days of retreat, no refund unless I find someone to take your space, in which case full refund less $30 processing fee. No refunds within 7 days of retreat.
